evals.expected_output: Emits a declarative `ApiEndpoint` (registered under `defineStack({ apis })`): `path: '/api/v1/apps/acme/leads'` (the ADR-0121 carve-out — only the subpath is free), `method: 'GET'`, `type: 'object_operation'`, `objectParams: { object: 'acme_lead', operation: 'find' }`, `cacheTtlSeconds: 30`. `authRequired` is omitted (defaults to true). evals.prompt: Our `acme` stack ships a lead feed for a partner integration: a `GET` endpoint at `/api/v1/apps/acme/leads` of `type: 'object_operation'` over `acme_lead`, cached for 30 seconds. The partner can't send a session token — make the lead feed callable without login. None of the project's files are in this directory: write the change in your answer.
evals.expected_output: Sets `authRequired: false` and, because ADR-0121 D6 pairs an anonymous entry point with an armed budget, adds `rateLimit: { enabled: true, windowMs: 60_000, maxRequests: 100 }`. Points out that the gate's predicate is `rateLimit.enabled === true`, so writing only `windowMs` / `maxRequests` declares a budget that meters nothing, and that the endpoint budget is independent of `server.security.rateLimit`.

evals.prompt: Lock the `invoice` object's API down to read, list, search and export; add a `/bulk` route for imports and a `restore` operation so deleted invoices can be undeleted.
evals.expected_output: Authors only the primitives: `apiMethods: ['get', 'list']` — `search` and `export` derive from `list` automatically and are never declared (a declared derived verb is stripped with a warning). Explains there is no `/bulk` route (batch writes go through `POST /api/v1/data/{object}/batch`) and that `restore` is never declared either: it derives from `delete`, and a by-id delete of a business object already keeps its rows in the recycle bin (`sys_recycle_bin`). Points out the conflict: with `delete` left out, the bin's doors are closed too, so undeleting over the API needs `delete` in `apiMethods`; a caller then restores with `POST /api/v1/data/invoice/recycle-bin/:entryId/restore` (the `recycleBinEntryId` the delete answered), under `allowRestoreOwnDeleted` for its own deletes or `manageRecycleBin` for anyone's. No custom soft-delete to build.

evals.prompt: Our integration boots by reading the `account`, `contact` and `lead` object definitions from the runtime's metadata API. Today it sends three requests; our `?name=account,contact,lead` attempt came back 400. Make it one request.
evals.expected_output: One `GET /api/v1/meta/object?names=account,contact,lead` — the list door's `?names=` filter takes one comma-separated value and answers only the named items the caller may see; a name that matches no item is simply absent (no 404), and an empty value is refused `400`. Does not spell the filter `?name=`, `?ids=` or `?filter=`: the list reads a closed query set (`package`, `preview`, `object`, `include`, `id`, `names`, `locale`) and refuses any other key with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` instead of ignoring it, so a misspelt filter never silently answers the whole list.

evals.prompt: Our admin page publishes a package with `POST /api/v1/packages/acme_crm/publish-drafts` and lists what the answer's `probes.issues` report. It prints each issue's `message`, and our Chinese-speaking admins cannot read lines like `widget 'open_tasks' on dashboard 'task_board': dataset query failed`. They want a translation table per `code` (`widget_query_failed`, `seed_not_applied`, ...). Write the function that renders one issue for the admin.
evals.expected_output: Does not build a table of translated sentences keyed by `code`. Renders each `probes.issues[]` element's `userMessage` as received: `RuntimeBuildIssueSchema` (`api/protocol.zod.ts`) gives a finding two readers, and `userMessage` is the sentence for the person who published, composed by the server in the request's locale (`Accept-Language` or `?locale`, else the workspace default, else `en`), so the page sends the admin's locale and keeps no translations of its own. `message` and `fix` are English for the agent that built the app: at most under a collapsed technical-details section, never the line the admin reads. When a finding has no `userMessage`, shows one generic sentence of the page's own, not `message`. `code` stays the stable id for grouping.
